remarks:
Welcome to this well-maintained tri-level home , comfortable and versatile layout with plenty of room to relax, entertain, and enjoy everyday living.  The home features both a living room and family room, providing flexible spaces for gatherings, movie nights, or quiet evenings at home Two gas fireplaces in the living room and family room adds warmth and ambiance to the home. 
Enjoy year-round comfort in the heated Florida room, a wonderful space for morning coffee, entertaining, or simply taking in views of the property.  Central air conditioning provides added comfort throughout the warmer months.
Step outside to a fenced yard,  privacy and a great space for outdoor activities, pets, gardening, or relaxing.
For the hobbyist, contractor, or anyone needing extra workspace, the property includes an impressive 20x20 workshop, providing plenty of room for projects, storage, and equipment.
A versatile tri-level layout, inviting living spaces, a heated Florida room, fenced yard, and spacious workshop make this property a wonderful place to call home.
